text: Maia Kobabe's Gender Queer: A Memoir drew a court order, a temporary removal and a request for an investigation. A Virginia court ordered Barnes and Noble and Virginia Beach Public Schools not to publish, sell, rent, lend or exhibit it to minors. Fairfax County Public Schools temporarily removed it after complaints that it contained sexually explicit language and scenes inappropriate for a juvenile audience, then decided to return it to its high school libraries after a review. Keller ISD officials said administrators removed it from a high school library "out of an abundance of caution," pending an investigation into how it had been selected and made available to students. State Rep. Jeff Cason asked Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton to investigate it and other books that might violate laws concerning pornography, child pornography and decency.
